summary: The M7/M8/M9 + serverless conversion is complete and correct against every acceptance criterion. The full gate `make check` is green (ruff, black --check, mypy strict, 138 pytest) and the serverless offline-boot check (`import api.index; test_client().get('/')`) returns 200 with 'Vandy Food Radar' and NO env vars set. SnapshotStore is the only durable store (SQLite untouched for local/dev): InMemorySnapshotStore is the offline default, UpstashSnapshotStore is a stdlib-urllib REST impl that swallows all HTTP/JSON errors (load->None, save best-effort) so a KV outage degrades to all-NEW and never raises; build_snapshot_store selects Upstash only when both env vars are set. detect_changes classifies NEW/TIME_CHANGED/VENUE_CHANGED/CANCELLED/UNCHANGED with the required CANCELLED>TIME>VENUE>NEW>UNCHANGED precedence and treats previous None/empty as all-NEW. /cron/refresh runs run_with_snapshot for the target day and returns RunReport+changes JSON with no in-process scheduler (no APScheduler/BackgroundScheduler/Thread symbol anywhere; Vercel Cron in vercel.json is the trigger). GoogleCalendarWriter is explicit-only, idempotent via a deterministic iCalUID='vfr-'+identity_key, disabled by default, never raises, and the google libs are imported lazily (verified not present in sys.modules after app boot). GoogleMapsLocationProvider memoizes by rounded (origin,dest), falls back maps->haversine->UNKNOWN, and an unknown walk uses the neutral 0.5 value (never zero). Every integration sits behind an interface and is offline-faked in tests; the 93 pre-existing tests are intact (base=93, now=138) and still pass. No blocker/major/minor findings.
